assertion.rationale: F9 (Task 13): 3.3.1's and 3.3.2's collection and traceability gaps are both closed. Key Vault, storage, SQL database and CAE diagnosticSettings plus the subscription Activity Log land in the Log Analytics workspace automatically via platform/main.bicep and layer-06-platform.yml; Entra ID SignInLogs/AuditLogs land in the same workspace once docs/runbooks/g0-bootstrap.md Section C item 12's documented command is run by a human holding Security Administrator or Global Administrator, after the first L6 deploy -- deliberately not automated, because that role is more standing tenant privilege than mls-github-deployer should carry (Task 10 narrowed this exact SP's Graph permission to shrink its blast radius, finding F8). Once item 12 has been run, cross-resource correlation in KQL against a single workspace spans both the Azure resource plane and the Entra identity plane -- correlating a suspicious Key Vault AuditEvent or SQL query against WHO authenticated to get there, or against a Conditional Access decision, is possible. lawDataRetentionDays is raised 30 -> 90 (platform/main.bicep), meeting the AU-11 convention and DFARS 252.204-7012(e)'s 90-day preservation obligation for all of it. This control's gap was explicitly bounded by whichever of 3.3.1/3.3.2 was worse; a prior pass downgraded its gapSeverity to medium alongside theirs for partial progress, reverted per 3.1.5.json's precedent that severity does not discount for partial progress. With 3.3.1 and 3.3.2 both now closed -- one piece by IaC, one piece by a documented G0 step the register treats as an equally valid remedy (the same standard item 4 already meets) -- this control closes too. Checked: no other finding in compliance/findings/2026-08-26-prepublication-review.md cites 3.3.5.

recommendation: None outstanding for this control. Run docs/runbooks/g0-bootstrap.md Section C item 12 once, after the first L6 deploy, so the identity-plane logs are available for correlation alongside the resource-plane logs already landing automatically. A regression in 3.3.1 or 3.3.2's collection would reopen this control along with them.
